observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox One X console with a black controller on top, placed on a red tufted couch. The console has a visible 'X' logo on the front right.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a different angle, with a black controller in front of it. The console appears to be the same model as in photo 0.
Both photos show a watermark 'LOVE FOR GADGET' across the image.
The console in both photos appears to be in good physical condition with no visible damage.
The controller in photo 0 is black and has a standard Xbox design with D-pad, analog sticks, and colored action buttons.
The controller in photo 1 has a gold-colored accent on the back, which may be a custom or aftermarket design.
No batteries are visible in either photo.
The seller claims '2 units of Xbox One X with One Controller each and batteries'.

identity.kind: Xbox One X console with one controller and one controller

claims.evidence: Only one console is visible in both photos. No second unit is shown.
One controller is visible in photo 0 and photo 1, placed on top of the console.
No batteries are visible in either photo. Their presence cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: The second console is not included as claimed
risks.proof: A photo showing both consoles together or a clear shot of the second unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as only one console, with no second unit included.

risks.risk: The controllers are not functional or are missing accessories
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the controllers powering on, connecting to the console, and responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-functional or missing accessories.

risks.risk: The batteries are not included or are dead
risks.proof: A photo showing the batteries included with the consoles, or a video of the consoles running without batteries.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as without batteries, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo showing both consoles together to confirm the second unit is included.
Video or photo showing the controllers powering on and connecting to the consoles.
Photo showing the batteries included with the consoles.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
